parameters.query:
WITH new_auction AS (
  INSERT INTO auctions (conversation_id, property_id, short_code, expires_at)
  VALUES (
    $1::uuid,
    $2,
    UPPER(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '') FROM 1 FOR 4)),
    NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  )
  RETURNING auction_id, short_code, expires_at
)
SELECT * FROM new_auction;

-- Calendar-scheduled on-shift agents (get_on_shift_agents honors agent_schedule, falls back to on_shift)
SELECT DISTINCT a.agent_id, a.name, a.whatsapp_number
FROM get_on_shift_agents() g
JOIN agents a ON a.agent_id = g.agent_id
UNION
-- Manager always (backup)
SELECT a.agent_id, a.name, a.whatsapp_number
FROM agents a WHERE a.agent_id = 'agent_manager'
UNION
-- Specifically assigned agent, if any
SELECT a.agent_id, a.name, a.whatsapp_number
FROM agents a WHERE a.agent_id = $1 AND $1 <> '__none__';

INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender_type, recipient_phone, body, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'outbound', 'system', $2, $3, $4::jsonb);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Build Fan-out Messages').item.json.conversation_id, $('Build Fan-out Messages').item.json.number, $('Build Fan-out Messages').item.json.text, JSON.stringify({ purpose: 'auction_notify', auction_id: $('Build Fan-out Messages').item.json.auction_id, agent_id: $('Build Fan-out Messages').item.json.agent_id })] }}

parameters.query: UPDATE auctions SET notified_agents = $1::text[] WHERE auction_id = $2::uuid;
